_comment: What this checkout instantiates, and where the platform comes from. ihris is a folio-assistant-core DEPENDENT repository, laid out as litlfred/who-iris is: ihris is local at `.`, and the platform layers are remote mounts pinned to 40-char SHAs, landed at `<name>/` (git-ignored, generated block in .gitignore) by `bash src/tools/mount_platform.sh`, never committed. folio-assistant-core is the one instance ihris `needs`; cat-harness, cat-harness-tools, bootstrap and bootstrap-tools are its closure, and fhir-harness is what the FHIR subgraphs (ihris5, ihris-4-on-fhir) need, pinned together at mutually consistent commits of each layer's main (the closure folio-assistant's own index is tested against). Bump the pins together. Schema: cat-harness/schemas/index-config.ts; skill: cat-harness's `index-config`.

remote.note: The content layer ihris needs: catalogue, glossary and materialization schemas (folio-catalogue(-node)/v1, folio-glossary/v1). Pinned at its main after the 70lx move (litlfred/folio-assistant-core#45), together with the rest of the closure.
